summaries.Romania: Romania faces a critical 30-day window to reverse a controversial ANI law that threatens EU funding, while political tensions escalate with AUR pushing Nicușor Dan's suspension and healthcare infrastructure investments accelerate despite budget constraints.

items.title: Oana Ţoiu, despre legea ANI: Mai sunt 30 de zile în care România poate şi să primească banii din PNRR şi să îndrepte această eroare / Preşedintele putea să fie un aliat mai bun

items.title: Trump admin blocks over $1.6B in potentially fraudulent Medicare lab payments: CMS
items.snippet: The CMS Fraud Defense Operations Center has also accounted for more than $371 million in Medicare suspended payments involving 267 providers and suppliers since Jan. 1, the agency said.
items.line: CMS blocks over $1.6B in potentially fraudulent Medicare lab payments as part of intensified fraud enforcement, with 267 providers under suspended payments.

items.title: Apple will be launching its first pair of smart glasses next year: Here’s what’s coming
items.snippet: As soon as next year, Apple will be debuting its first pair of AI-powered smart glasses. They’ll integrate Visual Intelligence and bring Siri to the real world. Here’s what we’re expecting.
items.line: Apple's first AI-powered smart glasses launching next year with Visual Intelligence and Siri integration, marking major expansion beyond iPhone ecosystem.

items.title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
items.snippet: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.
items.line: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic for 'brazen' intellectual property theft, seeking up to $150K per copyrighted work in landmark music-AI litigation.

items.line: Healthcare investments through PNRR will continue beyond current funding via the Operational Health Program, with Cluj neurochirurgy center and Târgu Mureș cardiac institute inaugurations marking progress.

items.title: Doi antreprenori români au lansat o aplicație pentru siguranța seniorilor. Cum funcționează
items.snippet: Razvan Gîrmacea, antreprenor român în serie, și Daniel Damian, directorul general al unei firme de marketing, au lansat o aplicație care alertează familiile atunci când telefonul unui părinte în vârstă rămâne neobișnuit de mult timp inactiv, fără a utiliza GPS, camere, microfoane sau confirmări ziln
items.line: Romanian entrepreneurs launch a senior safety app that alerts families without invasive tracking, addressing a critical gap in elderly care monitoring.

items.title: România încearcă să convingă SUA să păstreze trupele în țară. Oana Țoiu: „Americanii se uită la contribuția fiecărui stat”
items.snippet: Oana Țoiu a declarat sâmbătă seara, în exclusivitate la Digi24, că România face eforturi pentru a convinge SUA să păstreze trupele în țară, iar „un lucru esențial la care se uită americanii acum este contribuția fiecărui stat aliat”. Declarația vine după o întâlnire cu o delegaţie a Congresului SUA.
items.line: Romania actively lobbies US delegation to maintain American troop presence, emphasizing each ally's strategic contribution to NATO's European posture.

items.title: STAT+: A Novartis drug cut inflammation. Can it improve heart outcomes?
items.snippet: A newly acquired Novartis drug cut signs of inflammation. The test will be whether that can improve people's heart health.
items.line: Novartis drug successfully reduces inflammation markers, raising hopes for improved cardiac outcomes in clinical trials.

items.title: Costs tied to No Surprises Act's IDR process hit $22B in 2025, study finds
items.snippet: Costs associated with the No Surprises Act's dispute resolution process reached $22.4 billion at the end of 2025, according to a new analysis.
items.line: No Surprises Act dispute resolution costs hit $22.4B in 2025, revealing the expensive overhead of independent dispute resolution processes.

items.title: Limbic selected to FDA pilot, will test voice AI therapy with Medicare enrollees
items.snippet: Through TEMPO, Limbic will gather real-world data on outcomes, safety and how patients use the service, which will eventually support its application when it is ready to seek FDA approval.
items.line: Limbic's voice AI therapy selected for FDA TEMPO pilot program to test real-world outcomes with Medicare enrollees.

items.title: Apple Card keeps getting better, here’s everything new
